dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "No matter how long the night, the dawn will always come. No matter how weak the flames, the fire will never die!"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "Warriors of Natlan, rejoice! The Abyss has been defeated. Peace has arrived. We have attained victory once more!"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "Warriors of Natlan, rejoice! For the Pyro Archon, for Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini —the hero from a distant land — and for all those who sacrificed themselves so that we could see this day, rejoice!"
